description: The donut chart illustrates the win rates (%) of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—in generating empathetic responses, as evaluated by Gemini. The chart is divided into three segments: GPT-4o dominates with a 98.4% win rate, represented by a large dark red inner ring and a 96.8% outer ring (likely reflecting a slightly different metric or aggregation); LLaMA follows with a 3.2% win rate shown in light blue; and Mistral has the smallest share at 1.2%, depicted in a thin dark blue segment. The central white circle is labeled “Win rate (%)”, and each segment is clearly labeled with its corresponding model name and percentage, connected by lines for readability. The visual emphasizes GPT-4o’s overwhelming lead in empathetic response quality compared to the base LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 models.
